To find the stationary points of an equation y = f(x), you need to find the first derivative of the function, f'(x). Set the first derivative equal to zero and solve for x. These values of x are the critical points. To determine if these critical points are stationary points, you need to find the second derivative, f''(x), and evaluate it at the critical points.
